Austin's Story

23 Years Later,
He's Fighting Again

Austin was just a child when Chronic Myeloid Leukemia entered his life. Against the odds, a bone marrow transplant from his sister saved him — and he went on to build a beautiful life, a family, and a future full of hope.

Now, 23 years later, the CML has returned. Austin is once again undergoing treatment, and he is facing it with the same incredible strength he's always carried.

This dinner is our community's chance to wrap our arms around Austin and his family — to let them know they are loved, seen, and supported.

All proceeds go directly toward Austin's medical expenses and family living needs.
